overview.atmosphere: Historic thermal spa town in the Massif Central. Les Thermes du Mont-Dore. Val de Courre ski area above town (40km). Puy de Sancy nature area — highest peak in Massif Central (1,885m). Belle Époque architecture.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledging, hiking, Belle Époque architecture, casino.
